::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 21 [?1870]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown, formerly owned by Georgina Battiscombe.
:::

I do not go on the principle of no love at all, and letting nobody marry, but I do not think it will do to have it the whole subject and interest of the story.[^1]

---

[^1]: This fragment is quoted by Enid Huws Jones, *Mrs Humphry Ward*  (London : Heinemann, 1973), who states that the MS was then owned by Georgina Battiscombe.
[^2]: The letter is described as a rejection of a story called ‘A Gay Life’ as unsuitable for [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd).,
